title: Store Locator Map Builder: Locations Mapped
description: Build a store locator map from your own location list with the Store Locator Map Builder — nearest-first results, no platform lock-in. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a visitor at Times Square with three Manhattan-area stores sees them ranked 6.0, 11.0 and 13.5 miles away — nearest first, the only order a locator is allowed to use.

faq: What format should my location list be in?
Name plus address — or name plus coordinates for exactness — one location per entry, in the shape the builder's form shows. Coordinates remove the geocoder's guesswork entirely.
How many locations can it handle?
Small and mid-size networks comfortably — the locator's natural habitat. National chains with thousands of stores belong on database-backed platforms.
Each store's entry can hand off to the visitor's map app for directions — the locator finds the store, the phone's maps do the driving.
Can visitors search by ZIP or postcode?
Yes — the search resolves the code's area and ranks your stores by distance from it, the way customers actually think ('near 90210').
Does it collect my customers' locations?
The locator ranks for the visitor in their browser; a well-built locator (and this builder's philosophy) does not need to harvest searches to do its job.
The builder keeps the provider map's clean default look. Full brand theatre is the custom-platform tier — the honest trade of a free builder.
They belong in the list data you rebuild with — a locator is only as current as its last rebuild, which is why the rebuild is one paste away.
